subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public `skills.load` contract should OpenClaw expose for disabling built-in skill sources such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The fix adds public configuration surface and changes default built-in skill-source behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape or compatibility semantics on its own.

options.title: Approve typed source-disable config
options.body: Add a narrow enum/list of known skill source ids and apply it before loader discovery, watcher registration, status, docs, and tests.

options.title: Use the existing per-skill controls
options.body: Decline source-level configuration and document per-skill disables, agent allowlists, and prompt limits as the supported mitigation.

options.title: Defer to broader on-demand skills
options.body: Keep this open behind a larger context-selection design such as skill-driven plugin visibility instead of adding a source-specific control now.

recommendation.title: Approve typed source-disable config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow enum/list of known skill source ids and apply it before loader discovery, watcher registration, status, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the current skills loader/config/docs surface and is the clearest available owner for a public config decision.
